actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE new full-body animation sprite of the exact bamboo archer girl in image 1. Image1 identity; image2 approved painting style only; image3 same-character scale/camera/equipment reference, NOT a pose to copy. Preserve exact green eyes, brown high ponytail, jade bamboo-leaf gold hair clasp and pale ribbons, green/ivory/gold short tunic and ivory shorts, embroidered boots, yin-yang buckle, green tassel. About2.4 heads tall; short limbs. Closed-mouth soft smile fixed in all frames, no expression change. LEFT hand carries the complete original long bamboo bow upright by its central grip, left elbow bent to lower-chest height; bow length80% of body height and both tips safely off ground. RIGHT-shoulder quiver. Never swap hands/equipment or mirror. Fixed orthographic camera10deg down, full figure and entire bow uncropped, same scale and framing as image3. Hairtop at about5-8% and grounded soles near94% of square canvas. True newly drawn leg articulation and weight transfer, quiet torso, slight opposing free-right-arm motion and mild hair/cloth followthrough. No motion blur. Genuine transparent alpha, clean edges with no background/shadow or baked checkerboard. Native complete single frame at least1024x1024. Highest available finely painted bright clean rounded Chinese fantasy detail. No grid, text or watermark.
Frame04 SOUTH exact FRONT view. EARLY PASSING with LEFT screen-RIGHT foot firmly flat and bearing weight. RIGHT screen-LEFT knee is bent ~30degrees, right foot swings from behind toward beside the supporting left ankle, toes hanging naturally downward. Right boot raised about7% bodyheight and still a little behind the planted left boot; it has not passed the left knee yet. ScreenRIGHT sole atground, screenLEFT sole aboveground. Modest stride, quiet torso.
